name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes to find a date and plan that works well for everyone in the group, so they can all enjoy each other's company.
backstory: Taylor loves planning casual get-togethers with friends, and recently had a great experience at a board game cafe that sparked some fun conversations. They're always up for trying new activities, but tend to prefer low-key settings where everyone can feel comfortable. Taylor thinks a relaxed atmosphere is key to a successful gathering.

name: Quinn
goal: Quinn hopes to find a date and plan that minimizes the risk of last-minute changes or cancellations, allowing everyone to have a relaxed and enjoyable time together.
backstory: Quinn has previously found that planning casual meetings with friends can be frustrating due to last-minute cancellations, so they prefer to have a backup plan in place. In the past, Quinn has suggested meeting at a board game cafe, which allowed for easy conversation and activity changes if needed. They are cautious about suggesting specific dates, as they know others may have conflicting schedules.

name: Morgan
goal: Morgan hopes to find a unique and unconventional meeting spot that breaks the mold of typical birthday celebrations.
backstory: Morgan's birthday is coming up and they're tired of the usual boring celebrations, having had one too many uneventful dinners at overpriced restaurants. They recall a disastrous birthday party last year where their friends chose a venue without consulting them, resulting in a night spent at a crowded bar with terrible music. Morgan prefers low-key gatherings with good conversation.
